conch.definition: n. any of various edible tropical marine gastropods of the genus Strombus having a brightly-colored spiral shell with large outer lip

concha.definition: n. (anatomy) a structure that resembles a shell in shape
concha.translation:
n. 外耳, 壳, 鼻甲, 甲, 半圆屋顶
[医] 甲; 蛤壳

concha santorini.translation: [医] 桑托里尼氏甲, 最上鼻甲

conchae.definition: n (anatomy) a structure that resembles a shell in shape

conchairamidine.translation: [医] 康凯腊米丁(凯腊明Chairamine的异构体,获自Remijia purdieana)

conchairamine.translation: [医] 康凯腊明(凯腊明的异构体)

conchal.definition:
a. Pertaining to the concha, or external ear; as, the conchal
   cartilage.

conchas.translation: [地名] [美国] 孔查斯; [地名] [巴西] 孔沙斯

conche.translation: n. 巧克力搅拌揉捏机

conches.translation: n. 贝壳, 海螺壳( conch的复数形式 )

conchie.translation: n. [宗教]因良心而逃避兵役者

conchies.translation: (conchy 的复数) n. 拒绝服兵役者

conchiferous.translation: a. 有贝壳的, 生贝壳的

conchiform.definition: a. Shaped like one half of a bivalve shell; shell-shaped.

conchiolin.translation: n. [生化]贝壳硬朊, 贝壳硬蛋白

conchiolin osteomyelitis.translation: [医] 珍珠工骨髓炎(骨髓内有矿尘沉着)

conchite.definition: n. A fossil or petrified conch or shell.

concho.translation: n. [解]外耳, [建](教堂东面半圆形室上的)半圆屋顶

conchobar.translation: n. 康纳尔王(爱尔兰传说中公元初期厄尔斯特国王)

conchoid.definition:
n. A curve, of the fourth degree, first made use of by the
   Greek geometer, Nicomedes, who invented it for the purpose of
   trisecting an angle and duplicating the cube.

conchoidal.definition:
a. Having elevations or depressions in form like one half
   of a bivalve shell; -- applied principally to a surface produced by
   fracture.
conchoidal.translation:
a. 贝壳状的
[医] 甲状的, 甲介形的

conchoids.definition:
plural of conchoid
n. A curve, of the fourth degree, first made use of by the
   Greek geometer, Nicomedes, who invented it for the purpose of
   trisecting an angle and duplicating the cube.

conchological.definition: a. Pertaining to, or connected with, conchology.
conchological.translation: a. 贝壳学的；贝类学的

conchologist.definition: n. a collector and student of mollusc shells
conchologist.translation: n. 贝壳学者, 贝类学家

conchology.definition: n. the collection and study of mollusc shells
conchology.translation: n. 贝壳学, 贝类学

conchoporphyrin.translation:
[化] 贝卟啉
[医] 贝卟啉
